locations.notes: Farm save folders (name_id dirs with the save file + SaveGameInfo). Game-written XML — his actual progress, no executable content, and worthless as a malware persistence spot. This is the data the Chains 'git for save data' idea is built around.
Game options/settings the client writes. Classified down from data: machine-keyed settings, cheap to lose, and only reapplied after the game's own parse succeeds.
Error/crash logs. Taxonomic cache — diagnostic only, rebuilt by the game, never restored.
SMAPI mods are DLLs/so executed by the game from a user-writable directory — a textbook persistence hole. Reinstall mods from source after the rebuild; never carry binaries across the wipe.
